text:
Yes. Satellite data detected **0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2020**, about 0.02% of the property. The event met the tool’s corroboration rule: a later year was observed, and the JRC 2020 reference mapped the entire event area as forest.

The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the event area as planted pine forest and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest.

An additional 1.3 hectares of loss was detected in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, which were not counted as events.
